# NPM Improved v1.2.4

NPM Improved v1.2.4 keeps the same functionality and workflows, but makes the Control Center look and feel more like a practical administration tool.

## Less decoration, more utility

The overall interface has been flattened and tightened.

This release removes or reduces:

- decorative page gradients;
- glass/blur effects;
- large shadows;
- hover lift animations;
- oversized border radii;
- excessive pill-shaped controls;
- heavy heading weights and wide letter spacing;
- gradient primary buttons.

Cards, forms, tables, dropdowns, and dialogs now use simpler borders, smaller spacing, and more conventional admin-interface proportions.

## Simpler application shell

The top header is shorter and flatter.

The online/version indicator and account controls have been reduced in visual weight, and route subtitles are shorter and more practical.

The left navigation is now a straightforward dark administration sidebar without the previous glow, gradient, or animated active-state treatment.

Marketing-style copy in the sidebar has also been removed.

## Dashboard

The previous Dashboard opened with a large greeting, marketing-style hero panel, and decorative network/orbit illustration.

v1.2.4 replaces that with:

- a small Overview heading;
- direct Proxy Hosts and System Health actions;
- compact routing metrics;
- a plain Routing Summary panel;
- a normal High Availability panel.

The information is the same, but the page is much denser and more appropriate for something administrators use every day.

## Settings

Settings no longer repeats a large Settings title/description block inside the page when the application header already provides that context.

Desktop Settings navigation is now a compact conventional sidebar. Existing deep links and the mobile selector remain intact.

The Default Site screen has also been tightened:

- option rows use less vertical space;
- the extra decorative section icon is removed;
- template variables are shown in a compact table with copy buttons instead of large cards.

The Update screen keeps the improved workflow but presents installed/latest versions and the Update action with less visual emphasis.

## No feature removals

This is a presentation release.

NPMX, database migration, Shared MySQL, backup/recovery, update management, rollback, Default Site variables, certificate management, logs, Configuration History, System Health, and all existing routing functions remain in place.

The goal is simply for NPM Improved to look like a mature administration interface rather than a product showcase.
